blocks.text: Isaiah 19 belongs to a wider sequence in which Judah, Israel, and foreign nations are all subject to judgment. Empires may serve a purpose within that larger picture, yet they too remain accountable; the book also envisions nations learning, worshiping, and sharing in restoration. The Great Isaiah Scroll is an almost complete ancient witness to Isaiah, broadly aligned with the Masoretic tradition while differing from it in many spelling and some substantive details; other Isaiah manuscripts and interpretive writings show that the book was actively copied and interpreted.
